hero.title: Building systems that hold up to the brief.
hero.description: AA Spaces coordinates pre-engineered building solutions from early design thinking through fabrication planning and site erection — with the practical demands of the sector in view.

services.title: Structural planning
services.detail: Clear-span possibilities, internal circulation, loading conditions, and future growth are brought into the early conversation.

services.title: Building envelope
services.detail: Roof, wall, facade, daylighting, ventilation, and weather protection are considered as one coordinated system.

services.title: Fabrication coordination
services.detail: Components, connections, sequencing, and interfaces are organized to support an efficient build path.

services.title: On-site erection
services.detail: Delivery and assembly are coordinated around site conditions, access, safety, and the agreed construction sequence.

technical.title: A technical response, not a standard answer.

items.label: Span & volume
items.detail: Column grids and unobstructed zones are shaped around the real use of the floor plate.

items.label: Loads & conditions
items.detail: Structural considerations respond to operational loads, wind, location, and building purpose.

items.label: Climate & enclosure
items.detail: Envelope decisions take local conditions, daylight, heat, rain, and ventilation into account.

items.label: Interfaces & movement
items.detail: Entries, docks, equipment zones, people flow, and expansion points are planned as connected details.

items.name: Warehouses
items.detail: Storage-led spaces that support handling systems, clear movement, dock activity, and operational adaptability.

items.name: Commercial establishments
items.detail: High-visibility structures with the flexibility to support brand presence, visitors, and changing business use.

items.name: Hospitality structures
items.detail: Purposeful settings for guest arrival, circulation, service areas, and an experience that feels considered.

items.name: Industrial structures
items.detail: Robust building systems for manufacturing, processing, equipment, and the pace of everyday operations.

items.name: Convention centers
items.detail: Large-volume environments planned around gathering, adaptable programming, technical needs, and circulation.

process.title: One line of sight from concept to completion.

steps.title: Listen to the brief
steps.detail: We start with the site, use case, priorities, and the constraints that will shape the project.

steps.title: Coordinate the system
steps.detail: The structure and envelope are considered together, with critical interfaces surfaced early.

steps.title: Plan the build
steps.detail: Fabrication and erection are prepared around a clear sequence that respects the realities of the site.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.detail: The project moves toward handover through coordinated site delivery and review.

cta.title: Bring us the brief.
cta.description: Whether you have early sketches or a fully defined requirement, a focused conversation is the right first step.
